data.title: Story Bridge
data.description: Compare characters, settings, events, and big ideas across two illustrated stories.

stories.title: Sharing At The Library
stories.setting: a quiet room full of books
stories.opening: Afternoon sunlight shone through the tall library windows.
stories.closing: Both friends read together until the library closed.
stories.mainIdea: Sharing books makes reading time fun for everyone.

characters.name: Leo
characters.sentence: Leo wanted to read a dinosaur book.
characters.uniqueDetail: wanted a book about fierce dinosaurs

characters.name: Sam
characters.sentence: Sam offered to share the dinosaur book.

characters.name: Max
characters.sentence: Max smiled because sharing was fun.

stories.title: Sharing At School
stories.opening: Morning bells rang softly in the busy classroom.
stories.closing: Both friends painted together until the bell rang.
stories.mainIdea: Sharing supplies makes art time fun for everyone.

characters.name: Mia
characters.sentence: Mia wanted to use a bright red crayon.
characters.uniqueDetail: wanted a tool for drawing pictures

characters.name: Zoe
characters.sentence: Zoe offered to share the red crayon.

characters.name: Lily
characters.sentence: Lily smiled because sharing was kind.
